limitations: Active snapshot; later captures/receipts can exist outside the initial state cut. Final completeness awaits primary notice.
HTTP receipts retain response bodies with explicit preservation/sanitization flags; no request headers or complete wire request bodies retained.
Remote input bytes are verified by runner and hash proof retained in state; raw downloaded remote input bytes are not independently available.
Sanitized expanded result may redact transient URLs; Markdown is independently exact against retained provider string.
Returned job file_id/resolved version may be absent; do not infer direct availability or release pin.
Provider backend timing, actual HTTP dispatch latency, and wrapper observation elapsed remain distinct.
Completed usage credits are provider-returned subtotal, not final account bill or currency cost.
No credential access, provider/browser calls, jobs or retries by this audit; prior review baselines preserved.
